title: Context scorer weights (C1 augment FP-suppression)
description: Per-family logistic context false-positive-suppression weights consumed on-device by Detection/Scoring/ContextScorerWeights.swift as one additive log-odds term at the posterior seam. Decode by family name (never index). status 'placeholder' (B03) and 'candidates' (B04) stay in build/; promotion to 'calibrated' + install is Jesse-gated.

status.description: B03 ships 'placeholder' (every w_family 0, identity). B04 emits 'candidates' (trained, locked). 'calibrated' is the Jesse-gated installed final.

feature_order.description: The canonical 13-feature order; index authority shared with ContextFeatureContract.featureOrder (Swift) and the File-5 fire dump.

families.description: One logistic block per scored family, keyed by PresetThresholdVector.wireName(for:). MRN's key is 'mrn' (its cell_category_key is 'medicalrecord' — D-5).

feature_scales.description: Per-feature standardization scale; each strictly positive so Swift z = (f - mean)/scale never divides by zero.

w_family.description: Per-family gate set post-hoc by the harness verdict. 0 ⇒ identity (this family contributes nothing); 1 ⇒ active. Fractional reserved as a future damping knob.

support.description: Training-locus counts. Provenance only; not consumed Swift-side.
